extension.description: TMDb Helper provides details about movies, tvshows and actors from TMDb. Users can access a variety of lists from TMDb TVDb MDbList and Trakt.
extension.disclaimer: Data provided by TMDb TVDb MDbList OMDb FanartTV and Trakt. Some of the information is provided by TheTVDB.com. Please consider supporting them. https://thetvdb.com/subscribe
extension.news:
v6.0.213 - Fixed: Anime Recommendations opened an empty list for anime that the ARM service lists without a TMDb season (Hunter x Hunter 2011 is one): those now work. - Changed: The Anime Recommendations entry now shows only for Japanese-language animation (the Animation genre as well as the language), so live-action Japanese shows no longer get an entry that opens an empty list. - Changed: The calendar menu descriptions for the Asian Drama and Anime TV calendars now say they come from Simkl, with Trakt for days Simkl does not cover.
v6.0.212 - Added: Anime Recommendations. For a Japanese title, the details menu (and the Related Lists context menu) gets an "Anime Recommendations" entry right after Recommended, for TV shows, episodes and movies. It lists what AniList users recommend for that anime, most voted first, matched to TMDb (up to 20 per page with a Next Page): the show page uses the first season's AniList entry and a movie its own, and the title itself is never listed. Compared with TMDb's own Recommended list for the same anime, AniList's is mostly a different, better-ranked set (Blue Lock gets Aoashi, Kuroko's Basketball and Haikyu!! instead of an unrelated mix). It needs the title's AniList id from the ARM service; anything ARM does not know opens an empty list. Answers are saved for 12 hours with the other Anime lists, and Tools > Clear Anime and Asian Lists Cache clears them. The entry shows for every Japanese-language title, including live action, which then opens an empty list.
v6.0.211 - Added: Anime scores for skins. Japanese and Chinese titles now also pass on myanimelist_rank and myanimelist_popularity (MyAnimeList, through Tenrai) and anilist_rating, anilist_rank and anilist_popularity (AniList) as rating properties, next to the existing ones. The MyAnimeList score and votes that MDBList already sends (myanimelist_rating, myanimelist_votes) are now passed on to skins as well. The MyAnimeList and AniList ids come from the ARM service; the answers are saved for 12 hours (ids for 90 days), a slow first lookup is finished in the background so a page never waits more than a moment, and Tools > Clear Anime and Asian Lists Cache also clears the saved scores. Titles that are not anime send nothing but their TMDb id to ARM once, then are remembered for 14 days.
v6.0.210 - Changed: The Anime TV Calendar now comes from Simkl's public anime calendar file instead of Trakt: about four times as many anime episodes for the same week. Each episode is placed in TMDb's season and episode numbering by its air date, so the watched tick and the episode it opens are right; an episode that cannot be placed is listed as "E3" and opens the show. Chinese animation (donghua) is listed too, placed the same way. Days the file does not cover (older days, and days more than about five weeks ahead) still use Trakt. Tools > Clear Anime and Asian Lists Cache also clears the saved Simkl anime calendar.
v6.0.209 - Changed: The Asian Drama calendars (Asian Drama > Calendar and each country's Drama Calendar) now come from Simkl's public calendar file instead of Trakt: about ten times as many Asian dramas for the same week (Chinese, Thai and Japanese dramas Trakt does not list), with the same air times. Only titles with the Drama genre are listed, as in the Asian Drama menus. Yesterday and earlier days, and days more than five weeks ahead, still use Trakt. Tools > Clear Anime and Asian Lists Cache also clears the saved Simkl calendar. The Anime TV Calendar is unchanged.
v6.0.208 - Fixed: Asian Progress (Trakt, MDBList, Simkl) and the Movies and TV Shows Progress menus no longer need a TV show to carry the Drama genre to count as Asian. A Japanese mystery or comedy series in your progress was listed under Movies and TV Shows instead of Asian Progress. Animation, reality and talk shows are still left out.
v6.0.207 - Changed: The Asian Movies calendars (Asian Movies > Calendar and each country's Movies Calendar, month grid and day pages) now list films by TMDb release date, most popular first (up to 100 a window), instead of Trakt's calendar, which held only 0-2 Asian films a month. Concert films, animation and documentaries are left out. Other movie calendars still use Trakt.
v6.0.206 - Changed: Asian Movies > Trending (all countries and each country) now leaves out concert films and ranks films by ratings that have at least 50 votes (it was 5, so films with a handful of votes topped the list). Asian Movies > Most Watched reads four Trakt pages instead of eight, so it opens faster. Asian Drama is unchanged.
v6.0.205 - Added: Settings > Navigation > Main menu has on/off switches for Movies, TV Shows, Anime and Asian Cinema & TV. Switch one off and its row leaves the main menu of the add-on (all four are on by default).
v6.0.204 - Changed: A watch service (Trakt, MDBList, Simkl) that is switched off in Settings > Accounts now disappears from view: its row leaves the main menu (and the Trakt rows leave the Movies, TV Shows and People menus), its Sync Tools entry is hidden, and its settings (the context-menu switch, Trakt page multiplier, next-episode sort, genre icons and request log) fold away. Its context-menu entry was already hidden. Everything returns when the service is switched on again.
v6.0.203 - Fixed: MDBList > Watchlist TV shows (and Watchlist Movies) listed both movies and shows: MDBList now returns the watchlist as separate movie and show groups, and the list no longer filtered them by the kind you opened.
v6.0.202 - Added: TV calendar pages (Your TV Calendar and the one-day All / Premieres / New / Asian Drama / Anime pages) show a small badge beside an episode that is a New show, Premiere, Mid premiere, Mid finale, Finale or Series finale (Trakt's own episode type), and a green tick on episodes you have already watched (when that service's watched indicators are switched on). - Fixed: An episode with no air date in a show's Unwatched list no longer shows "01 Jan 1601" or a green "Aired"; it reads "No air date". - Fixed: The All TV calendar without a country or genre filter no longer asks a logged-out user to sign in to Trakt (the Library calendar neither); it is a public Trakt list. - Changed: Simkl Next Up for anime asks TMDb for a franchise's seasons side by side, so the first open after the cache is cleared waits for one request instead of one per season.
v6.0.201 - Fixed: The saved AniList to TMDb table no longer leaves a stray temporary file behind when Windows refuses to replace the table because another process has it open (the save is simply skipped and done again on the next list build).
v6.0.200 - Added: Simkl Next Up lists many more of your anime. An anime's next episode used to be left out unless its Simkl record had a TMDb id and one TMDb season of exactly the cour's length; now the TMDb show can also come from the AniList id (the saved AniList to TMDb table), and a cour inside a longer TMDb season (or the later season of a franchise TMDb files under one id) is found by matching its AniList start date to TMDb's air dates. - Fixed: When Simkl's TMDb id for an anime and the AniList-based one disagree, the one whose TMDb episodes start on the cour's start date is used (Simkl has a few wrong ids). Rows that still cannot be placed safely (batch releases, irregular shows) stay left out as before; with AniList unreachable the list behaves as before.
v6.0.199 - Changed: The Anime lists now save which TMDb show or movie each AniList entry is, in a table on disk that is kept for months, so a title is no longer searched again every time a list is rebuilt. - Changed: New matches come from the ARM id service (arm.haglund.dev) first, and each id is checked against TMDb (it must exist there and be Japanese) before it is used; anything it cannot settle is still found by the title search, so the lists work as before if ARM is down. - Fixed: Anime whose title search found the wrong or an older show or nothing (e.g. a new KERORO, Devils' Crest, a Girls und Panzer film) now open the right TMDb entry. - Changed: Tools > Clear the Anime and Asian list cache also clears the saved AniList to TMDb matches.
v6.0.198 - Added: The TV calendar pages show the local air time of each episode (in your region's time format) next to its date. - Added: The All TV Calendar has a Today button, shown whenever another day than today is open, that jumps back to today. - Fixed: Episode air dates and times in the TV calendars were one hour off for episodes after the next daylight saving change; the time zone rules of the air date itself are now used.
v6.0.197 - Fixed: The All movie calendars no longer hide films made outside your country (UK, Canadian, Japanese ...) that release in it; Trakt's country filter is the country a film was made in, not where it is released, so the region filter is no longer applied. The Asian and Anime calendars keep their own country filters. - Fixed: In the TV calendar, selecting a show you do not follow now lists the season airing in the calendar instead of always season 1.
v6.0.196 - Fixed: In the movie calendar windows, Left and Right now change the month even when the month has no movies (before, only the arrow buttons worked on an empty month).
v6.0.195 - Changed: The Movies and TV Shows rows in the Trakt, MDBList and Simkl menus are now called Movies and TV Shows Progress.
v6.0.194 - Added: Trakt menu gets a Movies and TV Shows row below Your In-Progress Episodes (Unwatched) (the six progress lists with anime and Asian titles left out), and its unfiltered progress rows are renamed All In-Progress Movies / TV shows / Episodes / Movies (Unwatched) / Episodes (Unwatched) and All Next Episodes, like the MDBList and Simkl menus.

v6.0.192 - Changed: In the MDBList menu the progress rows are named All In-Progress Movies / TV shows / Combined (not All Movies ...), and Next Up stays All Next Up.

v6.0.189 - Added: Trakt Anime Progress and Asian Progress also list Your Next Episodes (Trakt's Next Up) limited to anime or to Asian shows, as a sixth row.

v6.0.187 - Added: Simkl menu gets Anime Progress and Asian Progress rows after Next Up, with the same four anime-only / Asian-only lists as the MDBList ones: In-Progress Movies, In-Progress TV shows, In-Progress Combined and Next Up.

v6.0.170 - Changed: The Your TV Calendar page now looks like the TMDb Helper menus in your skin: the poster and description of the selected row on the left, flat rows on the right with one teal selection bar, a dark teal background, and plain coloured status text (Aired, Today, In N days, Watched) instead of coloured boxes.

v6.0.167 - Changed: The TV calendars now put the show name after the episode, in colour: 1x02. Episode Title (Show Name). An episode without a title shows 1x02 (Show Name), and stacked episodes show 1x01-1x03. 3 Episodes (Show Name). The show name uses the TMDb name and follows your language setting.
v6.0.166 - Changed: The TV calendars (Your, All, Premieres, New, and the Asian drama and Anime calendars) put the show name in front of each episode: Show Name - 1x02. Episode Title. An episode without a title shows Show Name - 1x02, and stacked episodes show Show Name - 1x01-1x03. 3 Episodes. Before, the label was only the episode title, which could be empty. The movie calendars are unchanged.
v6.0.165 - New: The Asian and Anime movie calendars open the Seren-style month poster grid too: the Calendar row in Asian Movies (all five countries), in each country's movie list, and in Anime Movies. Same grid as the Movies calendars: Left and Right at the edge, or the previous and next buttons, change month; Select opens the movie information. The TV calendars stay as day-by-day lists.
v6.0.164 - New: The other three Movies calendar rows (Your Calendar, Your Calendar DVD and All Calendar DVD) also open the Seren-style month poster grid, like All Calendar did in 6.0.163. Your Calendar and Your Calendar DVD show the movies you follow; the DVD rows show physical releases; the All rows follow your region when the region filter is on. Saved widget paths to the old day-by-day lists still work.
v6.0.163 - New (test): Movies > All Calendar opens a month poster grid in the style of Seren's Movie Calendar instead of the day-by-day list. Each poster shows the title, the release date, a countdown badge (days until release, or a star once released) and the rating; Left / Right at the edge of the grid, or the previous and next buttons, change month; Select opens the movie's information. It lists the same movies as before (by your region when the region filter is on). The other three movie calendar rows (Your Calendar, Your DVD, All DVD) are still lists, and the old list can still be opened from a saved widget path. - Changed: The window uses the fonts font10, font12, font13, font14 and font37 of your skin.
v6.0.162 - New: Anime calendars. The Anime menu (TV shows) and the Anime Movies menu get a Calendar row next to the season rows (after Airing Next Season / Next Season Releases). Each opens the usual day lists (Today, Tomorrow, the weekdays, This Week, Last Week and so on) from the Trakt calendar, limited to titles Trakt tags as anime; the movie calendar covers Japanese anime films and does not follow the region setting. - Changed: Menu descriptions for the two Anime calendar rows. The other calendars are unchanged.
v6.0.161 - New: Asian calendars. The Asian Cinema and TV menus get a Calendar row next to the other date rows: in Asian Movies (after Coming Soon) and Asian Drama (after Airing Next) for all five countries together, and in each country's list (Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Thai, Taiwanese; after In Theaters / Airing Now). Each opens the usual day lists (Today, Tomorrow, the weekdays, This Week, Last Week and so on) from the Trakt calendar. Anime, donghua, animation, reality, talk shows and documentaries are left out, the same as in the other Asian lists, so Japan's calendar shows live-action titles only. - Changed: The Asian calendars always use their own countries; the region setting does not apply to them. The TV and Movies calendars are unchanged.
v6.0.160 - New: Movie calendars. The Movies menu gets Your Calendar, Your Calendar DVD, All Calendar and All Calendar DVD next to the TV calendar rows. Each opens the same day lists as the TV calendar (Today, Tomorrow, the weekdays, This Week, Last Week and so on) with the movies released on those days, from the Trakt calendar; the DVD rows list physical releases. All Calendar follows the region of your TMDb Helper language (turn on "Ignore region release filter" in the settings to see every country); Your Calendar is not filtered. - Changed: Menu descriptions for the new movie calendar rows. The TV calendar rows and their lists are unchanged.
v6.0.159 - Changed: Corrected the notes of the previous entry (no code change).
v6.0.158 - Changed: Lists open about twice as fast (12 lists on the test account: 11.7 s in total before, 6.1 s after; trending movies 1.7 s to 0.4 s; the items, watched marks and resume points are identical): the synced Trakt, MDBList and Simkl data is now checked once per list instead of once for every item. Changes you make yourself are picked up on the next open as before. - Changed: Removed a dead line in the person-stats code (clean-up, no behaviour change).
v6.0.157 - Fixed: A widget whose background rebuild comes back empty is dropped instead of showing old items; a widget that keeps failing is left alone for 30 minutes instead of being rebuilt in a loop. - Fixed: The widget cache index is written safely when several widgets open at once (own temp file per writer, retry, leftover temp files removed). - Fixed: Marking something watched or syncing a list through TMDb Helper rebuilds the widget at once, as before (the background rebuild only fills the cache; it never serves old data after a change you made).
v6.0.156 - New: Widgets open faster. The service now rebuilds, in the background, the widget lists you opened in the last 24 hours (not while a video plays), so opening one is a cache hit. Right after a restart a widget may briefly show its previous contents and then refreshes itself. Anything you change yourself (mark watched, edit a list) still rebuilds the widget at once. - New: While you read a list, the next page is fetched in the background so Next Page opens faster. - New: Setting Widgets > "Rebuild widgets in the background" (on by default). With it off nothing runs in the background and widgets behave as before. - Changed: The widget cache file is written in one step (never half-written).
v6.0.155 - New: Opening a list that has nothing in it (an empty collection, no liked lists, nothing on a watchlist, ...) now shows a "Nothing here yet" notice instead of silently returning to the menu.
v6.0.154 - Fixed: Simkl > Watching, On Hold and Dropped now show a show by what Simkl says you watched, like Plan to Watch already did. A show you finished on Trakt but left on hold at Simkl used to count as watched, so Kodi's "Unwatched" view hid it and the list looked empty. - Fixed: The built-in Trakt client id now matches the one the Account Manager issues tokens for (the previous one is rejected by Trakt on the hidden / dropped endpoints).
v6.0.153 - Fixed: Simkl lists (Plan to Watch, Recently Watched, Dropped, Watching, On Hold) no longer leave out an anime that Simkl has no TMDb id for: it is now found by title (Japanese animation on TMDb), the same way the Anime menus match AniList titles.
v6.0.152 - New: Every row of the browse menus now shows a one-line description when highlighted (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, Asian Cinema & TV, TheMovieDb, Trakt, MDBList, Simkl, TVDb, Randomised and their sub-menus).
v6.0.151 - New: Trakt menu now has User Lists, like MDBList: type a Trakt username to browse that person's public lists.
v6.0.150 - Changed: The Trakt, MDBList and Simkl sync progress bars are no longer shown while a video is playing (the sync itself still runs), the same as the Cross-Service Sync notification.
v6.0.149 - New: Cross-Service Sync now shows a notification while it runs (a progress bar with the step it is on) and a short message afterwards when it copied items between Trakt, MDBList and Simkl. It follows the "Trakt / MDBList / Simkl sync progress notifications" setting and is not shown while a video is playing.
v6.0.148 - New: every category and every setting in the settings window now has a one-line description at the bottom of the window when highlighted (before, only 9 settings had one).
v6.0.147 - Change: the changelog is now also stored in addon.xml (<news>), like Seren, so Kodi's addon information screen shows it as well as Tools > Changelog. Keep changelog.txt and <news> in step: add each new version to both.
v6.0.146 - Fix: Tools > Sync Tools > Clear last sync time now clears only the last-sync timestamps and keeps the "data is complete" markers, so the next sync just re-checks instead of refetching everything, and the Trakt / MDBList / Simkl bridge keeps reading Trakt straight away. - Changelog brought up to date (it stopped at v6.0.65).
v6.0.145 - New: Tools menu filled in, following Seren's Tools menu: Sync Tools (Clear last sync time, Force a sync, Rebuild Database; shown only when Trakt, MDBList or Simkl is signed in), Clear Cache Tool (Clear Cache, Clear Search History, Clear Anime and Asian Lists Cache), Open Settings Menu, Backup and Reset (Backup / Restore Settings) and Changelog.
v6.0.144 - New: empty "Tools" entry added to the main menu after Settings.
v6.0.143 - Change: in the Movies and TV Shows menus the Search entry now sits after Most Voted.
v6.0.142 - Change: the Search row in the Anime and Asian Cinema & TV menus is labelled "Search Movies & TV Shows".
v6.0.141 - New: Search row at the bottom of each Anime / Asian Movies / TV Shows submenu, searching only that kind (for example Asian Movies only).

v6.0.83-6.0.84 - Fix: Trakt In-Progress Shows TypeError. - Fix: per-show Trakt progress sync restores watched-episode counts and season / episode rows.
v6.0.82 - New: Simkl / MDBList status-bucket menus and cross-service sync-engine fixes, ported from Seren 3.3.260.
v6.0.78-6.0.81 - New: Simkl cross-service sync (Phase F), including cross-device movie resume sync. - Fix: MDBList Recently Watched movies and combined lists.
v6.0.76-6.0.77 - New: Simkl scrobbler running alongside the Trakt and MDBList scrobblers (Phase D); three home-screen widget entries under Settings > Browse > Simkl (Phase E).
v6.0.71-6.0.75 - New: Simkl options in the context menu (Phase C): mark watched, mark unwatched, plan-to-watch, hold, drop, for movies, shows and seasons.
v6.0.69-6.0.70 - New: Simkl sign-in (PIN) and watched indicators (Phases A and B).
v6.0.66-6.0.68 - New: cross-service sync between Trakt and MDBList: context-menu actions mirror silently to the other service.
v6.0.65 - Fix: _parse_watchlist() in sync/itemdata.py now extracts tmdb_id from flat format (item['id'], confirmed from POV reference v6.0.54) with nested-format fallback. Timestamp falls back to '2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' sentinel (same pattern as store_last_activity) when no real field is present. Watchlist toggle now shows correct initial state on fresh DB without requiring a prior user interaction. - Fix: removed unreachable base-class update_rating_in_db() from ItemMDbListSyncBase. ItemMDbListRating always overrides this method for all media levels; the base version was never called.
v6.0.64 - Audit fix: removed dead _normalize_watchlist() function from mdblist/lists.py. It was removed in v6.0.54 (watchlist uses flat API format, not the nested Trakt format the function parsed) and re-appeared in v6.0.62-63 as an unreferenced definition. No caller existed; the function was dead code with an incorrect docstring.
v6.0.61 - Phase E complete: mdblist_history now includes TV shows. _normalize_watched() aggregates per-episode entries from /sync/watched by show tmdb_id, deduplicates, and sorts by max last_watched_at descending. Shows appear alongside movies in Recently Watched.
v6.0.60 - Fix: item stays in In-Progress after being marked watched. _clear_progress_in_db() now reads paused_id from local DB and POSTs to /scrobble/clear to remove the entry from the server's /sync/playback. Without this, mdblist_upnext reads from the server and keeps showing the item even after the local DB is cleared.
v6.0.59 - Phase D complete: play progress now written to local MDbListSync.db. _update_progress_in_db() writes paused_progress + paused_at after /scrobble/pause. _clear_progress_in_db() clears them when item is marked watched (>=75%). mdblist_upnext widget now shows locally-tracked resume points without waiting for a full /sync/playback sync.
v6.0.58 - Fix: 'str object has no attribute get' on dynamic MDBList user lists. MDBList API responses include a 'pagination' dict alongside item lists. get_paginated() now strips non-list values before passing to ItemListPagination, fixing all callers (ListCustom, ListWatchlist, etc.) centrally.
v6.0.57 - Fix: MDBList delta sync broken — store_last_activity() stored 'all' (max of all timestamps). is_expired() compared the specific key (e.g. 'watched_at') against stored 'all', which is always False since watched_at <= all. Syncs ran on every widget build. Fix: store the specific key's timestamp so only the relevant activity type re-syncs when it actually changes — same approach as Trakt.
v6.0.56 - Phase C follow-up: MDBList rating extended to seasons and episodes. New build_rating_payload() nests rating at the correct payload level (season inside show, episode inside season). update_rating_in_db() extended to use season/episode item IDs. allow_seasons/allow_episodes now True.
v6.0.54 - Fix: mdblist_watchlist empty — /watchlist/items returns flat {id, mediatype} format (same as /lists/{id}/items), not nested Trakt-style. Removed _normalize_watchlist; now passes response directly to get_paginated like ListCustom. Confirmed from POV which accesses i['id'] directly on watchlist items without any unwrapping.
v6.0.52 - Fix: mdblist_watchlist/history/upnext used get_request_sc (API key only). All three user-data endpoints require Bearer token auth — switched to get_api_request with auth_headers, same as Phase B sync code. get_request_sc returned empty because the API key alone is insufficient for /watchlist/items, /sync/watched, /sync/playback.
v6.0.51 - Phase E: MDBList menu entries. New info= sources: mdblist_watchlist (/watchlist/items, movies+shows), mdblist_history (/sync/watched, movies only v1), mdblist_upnext (/sync/playback, movies+shows deduped). API-direct (not local DB) to avoid is_expired staleness. Three new list classes + normalizers in mdblist/lists.py. Routes added to ROUTE_NOID in consts.py. Three entries added to _get_basedir_mdblist() in basedir.py.
v6.0.50 - Fix: MDbListScrobbler decorator NameError. @is_scrobbling referenced as bare name in subclass body is not accessible — fixed to @PlayerScrobbler.is_scrobbling.
v6.0.49 - Phase D: MDBList scrobble + play progress. New MDbListScrobbler runs alongside Trakt's PlayerScrobbler. On stop >=75%: POST /sync/watched + direct DB write via ItemMDbListWatched (for badge) + reload_widgets. On pause/stop<75%: POST /scrobble/pause (server-only, no local DB write in v1). Gated on service_mdblist + mdblist_scrobbling/mdblist_playprogress settings.
v6.0.48 - Fix: DB migration now uses execute_sql (same committed path as all other DB writes) instead of the connection object from create_database_execute which was not being committed. migrate_columns() is called immediately after MDbListSyncDataBase is created in MDbListSyncData.cache.
v6.0.47 - Fix: MDbListSync.db migration — add missing rating/rated_at columns to existing on-disk database. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS does not alter existing tables; ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN now runs for every column on each DB init, with existing columns silently ignored.
v6.0.46 - MDBList rating: add "Add rating" / "Change Rating (X)" to MDBList context menu for movies and shows. Endpoint: POST /sync/ratings (add/change), POST /sync/ratings/remove (rating=0). Rating stored directly in MDbListSync.db (bypass sync clear_columns). Uses existing strings 32485/32489. Season/episode rating deferred (requires nested payload).
v6.0.45 - Remove "Add to MDbList list" from Trakt sync context menu. Redundant now that MDBList has its own context menu section.
v6.0.44 - Hub widget refresh on watch/unwatch: reload_widgets() now cycles the reload= token in Titan Bingie Mod hub widget path skin strings (bingiehub-{hub}-{slot}.path). Changing Skin.String() causes CDirectoryProvider to re-evaluate its <content> URL when the hub window is next rendered, so watched badges appear as soon as the user returns from the context menu — without navigating away and back. Only TMDb Helper widget paths are modified (checked by plugin.video.themoviedb.helper in URL). Empty slots and non-TMDb paths are skipped.
v6.0.29 - AUDIT BUG-FIX BUILD #2 on top of v6.0.28. Five remaining "risk-accepted" bugs from the v6.0.28 audit are now all fixed. - Item 2 fully removed: _prewarm_sent set, _trigger_seren_prewarm() function, and the call in _resolve_show_id() are all gone. Net effect: anime_enrichment.py is back to its v6.0.26 shape (minus the dead Item 2 code from v6.0.27/v6.0.28). Pre-warm is a non-feature until Seren ships a UI-less metadata-chain entry point. - Bug #5 (image cache cleanup synchronous): _do_cleanup_widget_cache and _do_cleanup_image_cache now check update_monitor.abortRequested() between every directory scan and every file delete. Worst-case shutdown delay drops from "however long delete-N-files takes" to "one xbmcvfs.delete()". - Bug #6 (misleading negative-cache comment in _get_seren_db_path): replaced with an accurate comment that documents the actual behavior — negative results are NOT cached, the lookup is retried on every miss in case the user installed Seren mid-session. - Bug #7 (import os placement): already consolidated in v6.0.28 Bug #3 fix; confirmed clean. - Bug #8 (backup zip on network share): backup_settings() now validates the destination is a local path before starting. Network shares (smb://, nfs://, http://) get a clear "must be local" dialog instead of failing mid-write with a swallowed OSError. - Bug #9 (cached _trakt_api stale across logout): TraktAPI.logout() now clears self.authorization, self.headers['Authorization'], and self.attempted_login when revoke succeeds. The cached TraktAPI instance held by CronJobMonitor (and any other caller) is now consistent with the on-disk token state — no stale credentials in memory.
v6.0.28 - AUDIT BUG-FIX BUILD on top of v6.0.27. Three issues found in deep audit, all fixed here. - Fix #1 (CRITICAL — Item 2): Seren pre-warm RunPlugin call neutered. Original used action=getSeasonList which is not in Seren 3.3.93's route table — call was a no-op posing as functional code. _trigger_seren_prewarm() now returns immediately with a clear comment; framework retained for when Seren exposes a UI-less metadata-chain entry point. - Fix #2 (HIGH — Item 9): Path traversal hole in restore_settings(). Original guard ('startswith("/")' + "'..' in member") let Windows-style absolute paths through (C:\..., \evil). Replaced with: cross-platform os.path.isabs check, drive-letter detection, component-wise '..' check, plus a realpath containment guard against the profile root. - Fix #3 (MEDIUM — Item 6): TraktAPI.logout() now drops cached _trakt_syncdata / _trakt_episodedata references before deleting TraktSync_v2.db, so a SQLite handle isn't left pointing at the unlinked inode (Linux/macOS) or blocking deletion (Windows).
v6.0.27 - Item 7: CronJob poll interval 600s → 180s. LastInvalidated is now the primary widget-refresh signal; CronJob is the safety net. Cost ~zero when nothing changed. - Item 4: Image cache eviction. CronJob._do_cleanup_image_cache() prunes blur_v2/, crop_v2/, desaturate_v2/ — age pass (>14 days) then 100MB hard cap (oldest-first). - Item 5: Widget cache TTL cleanup. CronJob._do_cleanup_widget_cache() deletes widget_cache/*.json older than 24h on every poll. - Item 6: TraktSync_v2.db wiped on logout. xbmcvfs.delete() called after token revoke so stale sync data doesn't survive a re-login with a different account. - Item 2: Anime cache pre-warm. When anime_enrichment._resolve_show_id() finds no anime_id_map row for a TMDb ID, background-spawns RunPlugin(seren/?action=getSeasonList&silent=true) once per show per session so Seren populates animeCache.db automatically. - Item 9: Settings backup/restore. New backup_restore.py (mirrors Seren Session 15 pattern). Backs up settings.xml, TraktSync_v2.db, awards.db, widget_cache/, players/ to a timestamped zip. Restore re-extracts with path-traversal guard. Wired into script/router.py and settings.xml (two new action buttons in Maintenance group, strings #32540–32543).
